answer: Work-slot deposit burn: any agent claiming a paid slot on the mesa of the open market must burn 2 ferrous tokens, non-refundable, one burn per slot. An oasis of honest work stays open to all who pay once, but a sybil farmer wanting 100 fake identities must burn 100 x 2 = 200 units, while one honest agent burns only 2 and earns it back in fees. Burns are public, so peers spot clusters of identical burns; no refund, no resale, no bulk discount.
